_meta.purpose: Machine-readable seam declarations, consumed by arch-drift-check. Prose lives in CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/ — this file only adds what those can't: a parseable module -> barrel -> carve-outs -> test-dir list.

modules.name: edit
modules.importPatternNote: eslint matches both '@/lib/edit/*' and '**/edit/*' — this repo uses relative imports as often as the alias, and 'src/lib/edit' is the only edit/ directory in the tree so the segment match is safe. Do not copy this pattern into a repo with more than one edit/ directory (see aethr-portal).

carveOuts.reason: 14 client components behind "use client"; a barrel import from a server route would drag the whole section tree into a server bundle

imported by all 16 section components; routing through the barrel would make every built client site import the whole edit backend (Zod, both readers, the write path) to emit data-ae-* attributes no visitor ever sees

modules.conformanceScriptsNote: exempt from the lint rule — the module's own test seam, not callers

mirroredTo.note: never hand-edited; wiped and regenerated on every build. See that repo's seams.json for its consumption barrel.
